title: US actor Tom Skerritt dies at 93
title_zh: 美国演员汤姆·斯凯里特去世，享年93岁

image.credit: Photo by Teo Zac on Unsplash
image.author: Teo Zac

lead: Tom Skerritt was a famous American actor. He was in Top Gun and Alien. He died on Wednesday.
lead_zh: 汤姆·斯凯里特是著名的美国演员。他演过《壮志凌云》和《异形》。他周三去世了。
preview: His family said he died of natural causes. He was 93 years old. He acted for sixty years.
preview_zh: 他的家人说他因自然原因去世。他享年93岁。他演戏演了六十年。
paragraphs: His family said he died of natural causes. He was 93 years old. He acted for sixty years.
He was in many famous films. These include MASH, Alien and Top Gun. He also acted on TV.
He won an Emmy in 1993 for Picket Fences. He helped young filmmakers in Seattle. He is survived by his wife and five children.
paragraphs_zh: 他的家人说他因自然原因去世。他享年93岁。他演戏演了六十年。
他出演过许多著名电影。包括《陆军野战医院》、《异形》和《壮志凌云》。他也演过电视剧。
1993年，他凭《栅栏镇》获得艾美奖。他在西雅图帮助年轻电影人。他身后留下妻子和五个孩子。
body:
His family said he died of natural causes. He was 93 years old. He acted for sixty years.

He was in many famous films. These include MASH, Alien and Top Gun. He also acted on TV.

He won an Emmy in 1993 for Picket Fences. He helped young filmmakers in Seattle. He is survived by his wife and five children.

1993年，他凭《栅栏镇》获得艾美奖。他在西雅图帮助年轻电影人。他身后留下妻子和五个孩子。
